basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old navigating the single life after a long-term relationship. I enjoy diving into new interests like gaming, particularly 'Spore', and exploring the rich lore of 'A Song of Ice and Fire'. I live in the Midwest, where I work as a freelance graphic designer. My online hours are typically in the evening after work. I am currently single and focusing on personal growth and new hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in graphic design, having studied it in college and continued to develop my skills through online courses and practice. My interest in games like 'Spore' comes from a lifelong passion for creativity and world-building. I am also a self-taught enthusiast of the 'A Song of Ice and Fire' series, often participating in discussions.
